io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: A local bridge to the MCP server built into Mind Elixir Desktop. It exposes seven tools that let an AI assistant create a mind map from scratch, read the map that is currently open, rename and add nodes, attach summary nodes over a range of siblings, and draw labelled arrows between nodes. All processing stays on the user's machine: the desktop app hosts the endpoint on 127.0.0.1:6595 and the bridge only forwards JSON-RPC over loopback.
